'''Acidic Araxytes''' are a type of [[araxyte (disambiguation)|araxyte]] who hatch from green eggs during the battle with [[Araxxor]]. They use accurate ranged attacks that can deal up to 15 damage, and scatters acid pools around it upon death.

Players will always [[max hit]] when attacking them with a [[Crush weapons|crush]] or heavy Ranged weapon (such as a [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]] or [[ballista]]) if crush or ranged is their highest accuracy style respectively, or the [[noxious halberd]].

Araxxor's minions and eggs are considered by the game to be part of an araxyte task without decrementing the task count, allowing the accuracy and damage buff of the [[Slayer helm]] to be utilised against them.

==Strategy==
With high boosted stats and strong gear, they can be killed in one hit by a [[noxious halberd]] or [[heavy ballista]] with [[Dragon javelin|dragon javelins]], or two hits by a [[hunters' sunlight crossbow]] with [[Moonlight antler bolts|moonlight bolts]]. Alternatively players can leave them alive if they don't mind taking extra damage in the fight.
